Based on the ﬁlters speciﬁed in the pipeline YAML, selected projects (or spaces) will be extracted
once and fully synced to the target sink. Then continuous change monitoring will capture changes
as they occur and update the data in the sink. One exception is that the change monitoring syncs
only create and update actions, not delete actions.
